Yes, that's right. Clicking the × took "design" off this bookmark and told me clearly it was removed from *this* one — and I understand "design" is still around to use on other links, which is what I'd want. Removing a label from one bookmark shouldn't wipe it out everywhere; I just changed my mind about this single item.

That completes the labeling for me — I can add labels, reuse existing ones through suggestions, see them on the card, and take one back off when I've mislabeled something. Good.
